title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, unify caches, optimize matrix
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: our monolithic CI workflows have grown slow and brittle — lint/test/release jobs are bundled together which causes wasted GPU/runner time, long feedback loops, and complex caching semantics. This PR splits the workflows into three focused pipelines (lint, test, release), standardizes the cache keys across repositories, and reduces the build matrix to speed up common paths. Changes aim to reduce average CI wall time, improve cache hit rates, and make release automation easier to maintain.

What this PR does: - Adds three separate GitHub Actions workflows: ci-lint.yml, ci-test.yml, ci-release.yml. - Consolidates node/npm/cache keys and adds content-hash fallback to keep cross-repo cache compatibility. - Reduces test matrix by factoring out long-running integration jobs behind tags (integration=true) and defaulting PR runs to fast unit matrix. - Adds reusable workflow templates for lint/test steps to share policy and secrets handling. - Cleans up legacy release steps from the monorepo workflow and wires the release workflow to use the consolidated release action with improved artifact handling.

Testing and rollout: - Validated lint and unit test workflows on a sample of ~30 PRs in the redwood repo. - Ran canary release workflow against the release-candidate branch to validate tag and changelog generation. - Measured improvements: median PR CI latency down ~28%, cache hit rate up ~14% observed in canary runs.

Checklist: - [x] Split workflows and add templates - [x] Update repo-level documentation (CONTRIBUTING.md) - [x] Validate caches on canary branch - [x] Add reviewers and address infra comments - [x] Ensure release automation still signs artifacts

Notes: this is a non-breaking infra change; individual projects may adjust their test matrix through the new reusable templates. Related Linear: ENG-3187.

review_comments: Diego Morales: Can we limit the test matrix so that most PRs only run unit tests by default? Long-running integration should be opt-in.
Ava Chen (author): Updated ci-test.yml to run unit matrix by default and introduced 'integration: true' label/gate for the longer jobs.
Priya Singh: Cache key collisions were observed in the canary run; suggest adding repository name + content hash. Also please ensure cache restores are optional failures.
Ava Chen: Switched to repo-aware cache keys and non-fatal cache restores, added scripts/cache-helpers.sh to build keys.
Marta Lopez: Approving after confirming release workflow still signs artifacts and publishes to the internal registry. Left a suggestion to add a short troubleshooting section to docs/ci/README.md.
CI Bot: Some jobs failed on first run due to flaky integration test; rerun passed. Logs attached in CI checks.
release_notes: Refactored CI workflows: split lint/test/release, unified cache keys, reduced default test matrix for faster PR feedback. No runtime changes to product code.
